prompt:
Add src/ledger/split.py with two functions.
allocate(money, weights) splits a Money into len(weights) Money parts in the same currency, proportional to the weights.
- Weights are ints or Decimals, all >= 0, at least one > 0; otherwise raise ValueError (TypeError for floats).
- The parts add up exactly to money, and every part is a whole number of minor units of the currency.
- Rounding: compute each exact share of the absolute amount in minor units; every part first gets its share rounded toward zero; the minor units still left over go one each to the parts with the largest discarded fractions, ties to the lower index. A negative amount is split like its absolute value, with every part negated.
settle(balances) takes a dict name -> Money (positive: the person is owed money; negative: the person owes money) and returns a list of payments (debtor, creditor, Money).
- All balances must be in one currency (else CurrencyMismatch) and add up to zero (else ValueError).
- Repeat until every balance is zero: the debtor who owes the most pays the creditor who is owed the most (ties: the alphabetically first name) the smaller of the two amounts. Do not modify the dict passed in.
One test in tests/ fails; fix the bug behind it.
Add tests for the new behaviour. Run all tests with: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
notes: calibration candidate (4b), stdlib only, built by lab/tasks/build_tasks.py; traps: half-even rounding (public); negative amounts split as mirrored absolute value; leftover units by largest fraction then index, never to zero weights; minor units per currency; settle must re-pick the largest debtor/creditor after every payment; do not mutate input
task_summary: Add exact proportional money allocation (largest remainder, negatives, minor units) and greedy debt settlement, and fix a failing rounding test; done when all unit tests pass.
